name: Hard techno (2020s revival)
lineage: Early-2020s techno-revival wave returning to aggressive 140-160 BPM tempo and distorted-industrial production after the long 2010s minimal-techno period. The genre crystallized through Berlin and Amsterdam underground rave scenes, with key labels including Klockworks, Token, and (popularly) the broader Mall Grab and DJ Plead-led Sydney-Berlin axis. TikTok and Instagram circulation accelerated the genre into mainstream commercial visibility 2021-2023.
